name: The first cold
description: The hearths went out while the sky still looked whole.

pages.title: The first cold
pages.text: The Pad-keepers kept the warmth, not the fires — banked heat in thin dirt that let a family sleep through a long dark. They felt the Cut before anyone named it. Pads got cold. Bread took longer to rise. Moss would not take.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: They carried dirt in baskets, a pad at a time, and set a hearth on every scrap they saved. That is why you have a pad at all.

pages.title: What Soil remembers
pages.text: Seat Soil and the pad starts mending you. That is not a blessing invented for Skybound. It is the old hearth-trick, scaled down to whatever dirt is left. The Strand still knows how to keep a body warm if you ask it in the old way: a token, a Post, a promise kept.
